notes.title: Duke Nukem joins the crew!
notes.content:
When your crew is facing deep-space disaster, you can always rely on one man to rock up at the eleventh hour and save your sorry butts… [b]Duke Nukem![/b] That’s why we've enlisted legendary voice actor, [b]Jon St. John[/b], to provide the voice for the final crew member in their laser-powered, space survival strategy game, The Captain is Dead. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/bac7cb902bc511bf0d5df1ada0746a939049a1d2.jpg[/img]

[h1]N U K E M[/h1]
Jon lends his inimitable brand of machismo to the ship’s lovable (but slightly over-reaching)  underdog,  the [b]Janitor[/b], whose ability to fix shipboard systems with nothing but duct tape and chewing gum has made him a favourite amongst players of the original board game.

[previewyoutube=g4_O3LTclTc;full][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/a4c56ae84f75082887eaa9c12ae0ebc06b5e432f.jpg[/img][/previewyoutube]

Mr. Nukem himself joins an impressive and diverse cast featuring [b]Elias Toufexis[/b] (Deus Ex, Assassin’s Creed), [b]Lani Minella [/b](Mass Effect, Professor Layton) and [b]Kevan Brighting[/b] (Portal, The Stanley Parable). So when you need to introduce an alien invader to the business end of your boot, you know the accompanying one-liner will be stylishly delivered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/e8e6651424a67cbffe2977f8c6cd75e6c98421bc.png[/img]
[h1]B O W I E[/h1]
And have you ever wondered what Mr. Spok would sound like if he was played by David Bowie? Well now you don’t have to! Along with the Janitor, the [b]First Officer[/b] is also beaming up, rounding out the crew to its full complement of 18 members. This softly spoken, effortlessly cool commander brings a whole new set of tactics for dealing with the imminent alien threat – selecting him for your crew is the logical choice!

[h1]M O R E ![/h1]
These two new space-farers are joined by a host of updates and improvements, including an increased [b]crew size[/b], rule updates and [b]online leader-boards[/b] so you can prove to your friends once and for all that you are the baddest dude in the galaxy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1126580/The_Captain_is_Dead/

notes.title: It's the Final Countdown...
notes.content:
Stand by for action, brave commanders!
Here at Thunderbox HQ we're getting ready for our final crew update, and it's a good one...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/a4c56ae84f75082887eaa9c12ae0ebc06b5e432f.jpg[/img]

This update will finally max out the crew roster (to 18), and adds numerous enhancements. 

Joining the existing crew are [b]The First Officer[/b] and [b]Janitor[/b] - bringing totally new strategies to the game with their unique set of abilities...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/09cf9e4f895c0321fbc40781cfac2354d52772da.png[/img]

[h1]L O G I C A L[/h1]
The deceased captain's [i]Number One[/i] brings a distinct tactical advantage to your crew, with his mastery of [i]Battle Plans[/i]. Able to draw these game-changing cards more efficiently than other crew members, the First Officer can be powered up to select any plan he chooses... particularly handy when the dilithium hits the fan.

[h1]I M M A C U L A T E[/h1]
If you like the floors on your spaceship to sparkle like a crystalline entity, then the Janitor's your man! He may like to think of himself as the sheriff, but his improvisational know-how lets him use [i]Action[/i] points as wild [i]Skills[/i], enabling him to repair pretty much anything, anytime, anywhere!

[h1]E N H A N C E D[/h1]
And new crew isn't the only torpedo in our tube - we're busy adding a ton of enhancements, including...

[list]
[*] Improved Tactical HUD
[*] WASD scrolling
[*] Crewman loadout selection
[*] Maximum crew to 7
[*] Steam leaderboards
[*] And more!
[/list]
[h1]S E C R E T S[/h1]
We also have a [i]biiiiiiig secret[/i] about one of the final two characters, that we're not quite ready to share just yet. If you want to find out what it is, head on over to [url=https://discord.gg/v3Zzgva]Discord[/url] to join the final round of beta testing. All we can say for now is that we've had to take the [i]nuclear[/i] option...

[url=https://discord.gg/v3Zzgva][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/45ceae2eb8d6557dec2dfcdfe86dd750c44a144a.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Three to beam up!
notes.content:
New crew have just beamed aboard... and not a moment too soon! Get ready to turn the tide of battle as three versatile new specialists join the fight...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/44f4dfaa08fcdc8f2772f36529b5c222b48799f2.png[/img]

[h1]D I P L O M A C Y[/h1]
Maybe those pesky space aliens are just getting their [i]Darmok and Jalad at Tanagra[/i] confused with [i]Shaka when the walls fell[/i]? Or maybe they need another dose of hot laser justice? Either way, the [b]Diplomat[/b] can help you out! With her Command prowess, and ability to override Alerts whenever she heckin' well pleases, she's always ready to unleash [i]Uzano's army... with fists open![/i]

[h1]T E L E P A T H Y[/h1]
Cloaking devices and tentaclular probes are no match for the power of the mind! The [b]Telepath[/b] can wield the combined prowess of nearby team-mates, making him extremely powerful when deployed as part of a well balanced crew. Mind-meld clever crew combos to turn him into an unstoppable, psychic one-man-army!

[h1]S C I E N C E Y[/h1]
If in doubt... science it up! When she's not busy researching spores, molds and fungus, the [b]Science Officer[/b] can unleash her superior intellect to to upgrade the ship, or unravel the darkest mysteries of the cosmos. And she'll get bonus Skills for researching Anomalies too!

With these three seasoned officers added to your roster, you now have even more ways to die horribly in the icy darkness of deep, deep space!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1126580/The_Captain_is_Dead/

notes.title: The Telepath beams aboard!
notes.content:
...Your thoughts to my thoughts!

It's time for the Beta Channel to get cosmic with the addition of a mysterious, new crew member:
[b]The Telepath![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/f4c22e760c60b55665ff4b3c60721ed03b18b3a4.png[/img]

[h1]P S Y C H I C[/h1]
The Telepath can use his mind-bending power to trade skills with any crew member on the ship without the use of the Comm System. This means that he can boost his abilities even when under attack from Alien Soldiers, or in the presence of a debilitating sub-space Anomaly!

[h1]P O W E R F U L[/h1]
On top of this, the Telepath can absorb the Discounts of any crew member in the same room... and these discounts stack! Need to fix the Jump Core ASAP? No problem! Just pop the Telepath in Engineering with the Weapons Officer and Chief Engineer for a triple repair discount. Pick up a Torch en route and the Jump Core will practically fix itself! [b]BEHOLD THE COSMIC POWER!!![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/5e4758858a87d1ce4272c156df426bdbc648ea5d.jpg[/img]

[h1]B E T A v 1 . 3 2[/h1]
So grab the latest beta to recruit this master of the mysterious, and get your ship safely back to stardock with the power of the mind!

notes.title: New Crew Incoming!
notes.content:
Fresh Update incoming!!! Check out new crew and features for [b]The Captain is Dead[/b]!

[h1]U P D A T E   v 1.3[/h1]
The latest update brings the [b]Medical and Weapons Officers[/b] to the main build, ready to heal injured crew while grumbling incoherently, and dispense smooth torpedo justice to any jive-talking alien spaceships lurking off your starboard bow.

You'll also notice the crew are a little... [i]chattier[/i] than before, as the new banter system has been shaken down and integrated into the main release!

[h1]B O N U S[/h1]
On top of this, brave space adventurers on the [b]Beta Channel[/b] get TCID's answer to Chrisjen Avasarala, in the form of the no-nonsense [b]Diplomat[/b], whose mad negotiational skillz allow her to override alerts on other crew member's turns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/f48aa4e70dc90b13836f14a2f2d96b7c97b154a6.png[/img]

...and if the Diplomat's voice sounds familiar, that's because you'll have heard it in games like Mass Effect, Starcraft and Professor Layton. Bonus points if you can work out which characters!

[h1]F U T U R E[/h1]
And stay tuned to the beta channel for more crew as soon as they are ready to rock. Over the coming weeks we'll be introducing....
[list]
[*] [b]Telepath[/b] - this master of mysticism can trade skills without the Comm System and absorb the unique skills of nearby crew.
[*] [b]Science Officer[/b] - want to upgrade your ship or frazzle away those pesky sub-space Anomalies? Then this crazy lady has got you covered!
[/list]...with more to come!

That's it for now. Have fun with the new crew!
Sincerely,
Dan
Thunderbox Entertainment

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1126580/The_Captain_is_Dead/

notes.title: The Mission Continues...
notes.content:
Space... The final frontier... Our mission continues... to bring you more crew... more features... and more laser-to-face danger!

[h1]C R E W[/h1]
Get ready for the [b]next crew members[/b] to beam aboard: The Weapons and Medical Officers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/6df8acec8f2046de28dcf45cefbaa457743814d3.png[/img]
The [b]Weapons Officer[/b] is a smooth operator... but you wouldn't like to see him angry! His mastery of torpedoes makes short work of any pesky alien ships that are hanging around the starboard bow turning your shields into Swiss cheese.

The [b]Medical Officer[/b] is a rough diamond, more at home on his horse than in deep space. His extensive medical training will keep your crew fighting fit, although his bed-side manner does leave a bit to be desired.

[h1]B E T A[/h1]
Both of these new crew members have just been activated on the [b]beta channel[/b], so we can polish them thoroughly before the official release. We rely on your feedback to make [b]The Captain is Dead[/b] great, so please do take them for a spin. It's easy....

1)[b] Right click [/b]on The Captain is Dead in your Steam library and select [b]Properties[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/c2542573223bb887856f22490ad97f4087423ef9.jpg[/img]

2) In the Properties panel select [b]BETAS [/b]from the side menu, and use the [b]drop down menu[/b] to join the Beta channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/49852d6f153c2465691f10458952147ecc6d62e9.jpg[/img]

3) Close the window, wait for the [b]update [/b]to install, and enjoy [b]VIP access[/b] to new crew.

Worried about the beta being a bit shonky? Don't be! Features and crew on the beta will always be [b]fully operational[/b], with just a few teeny-tiny bits of work still to do (like sound effect tuning, voice tweaks or localization).

If you spot a bug that we've missed, or have an idea on how the game could be better,  just type [b]T C I D[/b] to reveal the secret [b]feedback button[/b] at the top of the screen, and [b]hit it[/b] to send a screenshot and your save game directly to our task list. BOOM!

[h1]B A N T E R[/h1]
And, as usual, new crew aren't [i]all [/i]you'll find in the latest beta... we've also made your team a little chattier! We could tell you more, but that would spoil the surprise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/482d2950f84ac64b1cc6d05a7c6f836b13463625.jpg[/img]

So grab the game, beam up your new crew, and strap yourself into the captain's chair... because more danger is on the way!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1126580/The_Captain_is_Dead/

notes.title: Achievement Hunters Wanted!
notes.content:
We've been working like crazy on the next update, and I'm excited to say that it's a biggie!

Aside from a major pass on the animation, to improve the silky smoothness, we're adding two new characters (the versatile Hologram, and mysterious Scholar) and [b]36 brand-new achievements[/b].

You may have already heard that these [b]Medals[/b] (as we like to call them) are all rock hard. Our team have only been able to hit a paltry nine of them so far...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/e30cbe4e6dda513960298490d7af9e2123b319d3.jpg[/img]

That's why we need help from you - the fearless, alien-fighting, ship-saving badasses - to make absolutely sure they all work as intended!

If you are going on an achievement hunt, you might want to arm yourself with the following knowledge...
[list]
[*] You can view your Medal collection at any time from the [b]Settings[/b] menu under [b]Game -> Medals[/b].
[*] Click on a Medal to read the [b]win conditions[/b]... working them out is half the battle!
[*] Some of the Medals are [b]hidden[/b]... these are character based and will be revealed if you start a game with the appropriate crew member.
[*] Typing T-C-I-D will make the bug button appear at the top of the screen so you can use it to send feedback.
[*] The Medals are [b]not easy[/b] to get! Did we mention this already... don't expect a space cakewalk, m'kay!
[/list]Just sign up to the [url=https://www.technipages.com/how-to-opt-into-a-game-beta-on-steam]beta channel[/url], let the auto-updater work its magic, and then go save that ship!

[h2]WAIT![/h2] I almost forgot...

New crew incoming! You'll also get the Scholar with the latest beta update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/7d31580ce1b17c1223ed125d91366b5354a3e9be.png[/img]

This wise, and mysterious lady will make getting those achievements juuuust that little bit easier. And trust me, you'll need all the help you can get!

Join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/v3Zzgva][b]Discord[/b][/url] to let us know how you do- we are standing by to be suitably impressed by your epic Medal collections!

notes.title: Achievements are coming soon...
notes.content:
Let's cut straight to the chase here, people: [b]Achievements are for the weak![/b]

Most games reward you for just booting them up... but not [b]The Captain is Dead[/b]. No sirree!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/ce17eec7eb5b214052c47466ed2f86dcf10a24db.jpg[/img]

We've decided to do things differently with our Achievements, and have crafted them with the following tenets in mind...
[list]
[*] To have [b]value[/b], they must require [b]effort[/b].
[*] To reflect [b]mastery[/b], they must encourage [b]advanced techniques[/b].
[*] To have [b]meaning[/b], they must stay in [b]context[/b].
[*] To [b]respect [/b]the player, there must be [b]no grinding[/b].
[/list]That's why you won't get Achievements in The Captain is Dead, you'll get [b]Medals[/b].

Each medal requires the use of a different crew member or advanced technique to attain it, and getting your hands on that sweet, sweet chest-candy won't be easy.  In fact, just working out exactly what you have to do to win a medal will be part of the challenge.

The easiest one is to save the ship... and we all know just how difficult [i]that[/i] is. After that they just get tougher.  We've worked with the valiant commanders on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/v3Zzgva]Discord[/url][/b] channel to create some truly epic throw-downs. Have you got what it takes to perform a [b]Krangon Death Ritual[/b]? Do you think you can beat the no-win scenario to collect the [b]Kobayashi Star[/b]? You'll be able to find out soon, as we're very nearly done getting all [b]36[/b] Medals into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/183996f3752930ead2ef05c52b2ff4f57b0dea88.jpg[/img]

So pick your crew, and get practicing, because these formidable challenges will [i]really[/i] put your alien-blasting, system-repairing, ship-saving skills to the test!

notes.title: v1.1 Update - Time to get Tactical!
notes.content:
Ahoy there, crew! Our first update is officially live today, adding (among other things) [b]2 new crew members[/b]  to your team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/6cb1badefa2eb594946db983fab4e23239bbbac5.png[/img]
The [b]Teleporter Chief[/b] can get you what you need, where you need it. He'll keep your systems running smoothly, and can beam crew and tools around the ship for free. Use his mastery of teleportation to sneak weapons to other crew members when aliens are in the room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/ec98b2c0e6ddfc8f2477be238a2dc401fac7d3d8.png[/img]
From her command post on the Bridge, the [b]Tactical Officer[/b] can deploy her unique abilities to keep the shields fully powered, and the crew stocked up on Skills. And if you need to crack off a torpedo, the Chief can always beam her to the Armory to bust out some explosive justice!

With more crew to chose from, the[b] team size has been upped to 5 characters[/b], so you can pair Chiefy and the Tac. Officer with 3 more specialists to create the ultimate squad. Why not partner up with 4 of your mates using Steam Remote Play Together, and combine your sci-fi survival skills to save the ship as an effective combat team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/9b8eba01a7d5f3a8e2cb7234ed8ad5ad99006212.png[/img]

But that's not all! We've been keeping a beady eye on your feedback in the Steam Community, and have made a major enhancement to the game's UI. If you're already familiar with the original board game, or reckon you've got a handle on the outer-space mayhem, and want to optimize your strategizing, you can pop open the settings and switch to the all-new [b]Tactical HUD[/b] for enhanced situational awareness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/deaabeda75ef5071d504f461ff98c815231e3053.jpg[/img] 

Along with numerous bug fixes (thanks again, Steam Community!) and a handy-dandy [b]crew randomizer[/b], the v1.1 update makes the Captain even deader than ever!

As usual, we're standing by on Discord to hear your feedback, and swap strategies, so pop over and let us know what you reckon, so we can make the game even better with the next update!

[url=https://discord.gg/v3Zzgva][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/45ceae2eb8d6557dec2dfcdfe86dd750c44a144a.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: New crew are on the way...
notes.content:
Here at Thunderbox HQ we've been working away diligently on upgrading and improving your starship!

We'd like to share a quick road-map of what's coming up in the not-too-distant future...

[h2]More Crew![/h2]
We're aiming to deliver a new crewman roughly every month, starting very, very soon. The next three space cases to join your intrepid team will be...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/40b58582286d8fa35ed6f4738b248b478c94ce66.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Teleporter Chief[/b] - this surly gent is an expert at beaming both crew and tools alike.
[*][b]Tactical Officer[/b] - from her post on the Bridge, she can keep the shields up, and the skills flowing.
[*][b]Hologram[/b] - laser beams pass straight through him, making him real handy when aliens are around.
[/list]We'll be releasing the crew in sets of two, so keep your comm frequency open for more news! But if you want to break the temporal prime directive, then you can travel to the future and get the characters early... just activate [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/application/branches]beta mode[/url] in the game's properties.  You'll find the [b]Teleporter Chief[/b] is already waiting for you!

[h2]More Features![/h2]
Along with the extra laser fodder, we're also adding strange, new [i]stuff[/i] to the game. Here are some of the new-fangled doo-dads we're upgrading the ship with...
[list]
[*] [b]Crew Randomiser [/b]- don't just play with the A-team*... Mix it up for even more disaster!
[*] [b]Tactical HUD[/b] - got a massive, hi-def monitor? Lucky you! See [i]everything[/i] from the main ship view...
[*] [b]Achievements [/b]- how could we not? Everybody loves achievements!
[/list]Check out this sneak, [b]work-in-progress[/b] peek of the Tac. HUD...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/8908afabd95bc413c450a0ad0d4bfffdc2569e53.jpg[/img]

That's it for now - if you have an idea for a feature, or want to make sure your favorite crew member is released right-frickin'-now, then join the melee on [url=https://discord.gg/v3Zzgva]Discord[/url]. We have laser pistols...

[url=https://discord.gg/v3Zzgva][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/45ceae2eb8d6557dec2dfcdfe86dd750c44a144a.jpg[/img][/url]

* If you're having trouble saving the ship... if no one else can help.... maybe you can hire... the A-Team... of Admiral, Chief Engineer, Soldier & Cyborg!

notes.title: Tabletop Fest - The Dice Tower vs. Deadly Mode
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcjigWovVb8

It's the last 10 minutes of your favourite sci-fi show… except that this time things have gone seriously wrong and [b]The Captain Is Dead![/b] Join [b]Mandi [/b]& [b]Suzanne [/b]from The Dice Tower, along with [b]Ashley [/b]from Meeple Mountain, as they try out a new, extra dangerous rule variant exclusive to the digital edition of this stylishly intense, sci-fi, survival/strategy game.

It's called [i][b]Deadly Mode[/b][/i]... how hard could it be?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/35275f7c0436c51c192fa584c295a08667f81fad.jpg[/img]

The cardboard and digital game designers, [b]JT Smith[/b] and [b]Dan Taylor[/b], will be live in the chat to answer questions, and gasp in horror as the ship catches fire.

Will our team survive the alien onslaught... or end up as space dust? [i]Tune in to find out![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1126580/The_Captain_is_Dead/

[h1]Starring...[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/0d430417c7c744ea20a5529092b00ea87fde70fd.jpg[/img]
Mandi is a member of [b]The Dice Tower[/b] Team where she co-hosts the bi-weekly Dice Tower podcast and also appears on The Dice Tower's Monday night "Teach and Plays". She also creates video reviews on the [b]To Die For[/b] Games YouTube Channel, of which she is the Founder.  Favorite games that you can find on her shelf are: Viticulture, Food Chain Magnate, Caverna and Trajan, just to name a few.  She enjoys pinup fashion and is easily recognizable by her hair colour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/17440cacce523802121c9bcb77b12dec18d0cd16.jpg[/img]
Suzanne also hosts [b]The Dice Tower[/b]'s bi-weekly podcast, and is an omnigamer who enjoys games of all sorts from party games to heavier Euros. She is known for being really loud at the game table and is sad that pie and fries aren’t more board game friendly foods. You can find her on Twitter as @425suzanne if you ever want to chat about games or get news on board game app sales. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/68a871fa6fec26df2348a2575e321471ea399c5c.jpg[/img]
Ashley is a regular contributor to [b]Meeple Mountain[/b], and appears on the [b]To Die For[/b] gaming channel on YouTube. She  considers herself a Euro-gamer at heart and Meeple Mountain's resident escape room gamer, but has also been known to enjoy the occasional Ameri-style game. Her favourite games are Ticket to Ride, Kanban, Pandemic, The Exit Series, Ganz Schön Clever and KLASK.

[h1]With this week's special guests...[/h1]

[speaker steamid="10732102" name="JT Smith" title="Founder" company="The Game Crafter" photo="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/01777567a3fa5fa16d246a386871ab00fb5a1822.png"]JT is the creator of the original [b]The Captain is Dead[/b] board game, and founder of [b]The Game Crafter[/b], the world’s first web-to-print game publishing company.
[/speaker]

[speaker steamid="1009624449" name="Dan Taylor" title="Design Director" company="Thunderbox" photo="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35524447/3e3c5a49088f244772735d34519106635b8ea130.png"]Dan is the Design DIrector at [b]Thunderbox Entertainment[/b], coming from a long history of AAA game design, including work on Medal of Honor, Hitman, Deus Ex and Tomb Raider.  His last board game project, a VR edition of Tsuro, was the first ever digital adaptation to win an [b]Origins Award[/b] from the Academy of Adventure Gaming and Arts.
[/speaker]
